title: Amos' Three Visions: Locusts, Fire, and a Plumb Line
description: The Lord shows Amos three visions: a swarm of locusts, a consuming fire, and a plumb line beside a wall. Amos' intercession for Jacob stops the first two judgments, but upon seeing the plumb line, the Lord declares that He will no longer spare Israel, and that the house of Jeroboam shall be struck by the sword.
